card.name: Cross-references to Warnings and Precautions
card.fires_on: The word "see" or "Warnings" inside bracketed cross-references like [see Warnings and Precautions (5.2)]. Also the period in section numbers such as (5.6), and the word "warning" in boxed-warning statements.

modes.label: Bracketed see
modes.description: The word see opening a section cross-reference in a highlights summary.
modes.example: appropriate treatment should be administered [<<see>> Patient Counseling Information (17) ].

modes.label: Warnings in cross-reference
modes.description: The start of the word Warnings in a cross-reference to Warnings and Precautions.
modes.example: SPRAVATO is available only through a restricted program under a REMS [see W<<arnings>> and Precautions (5.5

modes.label: Section number point
modes.description: The decimal point inside a section number in parentheses.
modes.example: evaluate promptly if colitis is suspected ( 5<<.>>6 ) Liver Injury: Clinically significant

card.plain: It fires where a label points the reader to another section, such as Warnings and Precautions.
